contentHtml:
Stop putting up with slow, patchy wi-fi. I design and install whole-home mesh networks that clear the dead zones, stop the buffering and dropouts, and deliver reliable, secure coverage to every corner of the house or office. I speed test every room before I leave, for homes and businesses around Stretton and Brisbane.

One router cannot cover a whole house

A single router broadcasts from one spot, and every wall, floor and appliance between it and your device weakens the signal. Southside homes make it harder than most, double-storey places lose speed upstairs, brick and rendered walls block the signal between rooms, and acreage blocks around Stretton and Karawatha need coverage out to sheds and granny flats a single router will never reach.

Mesh beats a cheap extender

A wi-fi extender is the usual band-aid, but it creates a second network you keep dropping off, and it halves the speed to do its job. A proper mesh uses several nodes working as one seamless network, so you stay connected as you move through the house without a second thought. I set up all the major brands, TP-Link Deco, eero, Google Nest, NETGEAR Orbi and more, and secure it properly.

Even better over cable

Mesh nodes work best when they talk to each other over a cable rather than stealing wi-fi bandwidth. If the layout allows, a bit of data cabling between nodes lifts the whole network, and for a simpler single-router home there is wireless home network setup.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
